title: Absence Relief Percentages by Care Level (Assisted Living)
content:
The relief percentage of the absence-relief credit under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement depends on the care level of the full-month care fee charge — the most recent full-month care fee charge on the residency — because the lower levels keep a fixed staffing cost while the resident is away.

| Care level on the full-month care fee charge | Relief percentage |
|---|---|
| Assisted Living Care Level 1 | 85 percent |
| Assisted Living Care Level 2 | 85 percent |
| Assisted Living Care Level 3 | 95 percent |
| Assisted Living Care Level 4 | 95 percent |

*Footnote.* A charge at Assisted Living Care Level 5 or Assisted Living Care Level 6 is not governed by this schedule. The percentage is read from the care level billed on that charge, not from the level the residency carries on the handling date.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A daily care fee of 60.00 and 10 credited days: at a Level 2 charge the credit is 600.00 multiplied by 85 percent, that is 510.00; at a Level 4 charge it is 600.00 multiplied by 95 percent, that is 570.00.
